root_cause.detail: The shipped final browser runner correctly required a measured pre-edit fit plan. The prepared artifact had only source-fallback opening, and the controller left plan execution to Luna. Luna skipped OMD_REFLOW_MODE=plan, edited once, then final runner failed with 'final mode requires a measured pre-edit fit plan'.

next_action: Move deterministic pre-edit browser planning into the controller before provider exposure, test it provider-free, then preregister a new root with the two unexposed tasks plus one fresh task.
